notes.title: Update Available Now!
notes.content:
Happy Tuesday Scrappers!

A new update is now available to download for PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe. 

We've been listening to community feedback and working away behind the scenes of Junktown to prepare an assortment of changes to share with you. Here's a quick overview of the latest update:

- Gameplay changes to reduce difficulty whilst playing solo, including:
  - Reduced enemy HP and frequency for solo play
  - Re-balanced challenge completion requirements for solo play
  - S.C.R.A.P will now deposit trash directly into your truck more frequently in solo play
 
- Changes to the network multiplayer UI to make it more convenient when playing online (Adding confirms on quit, remembering party codes etc.)
- Fix for audio being too loud on start up
- The settings menu is now available before the tutorial
- Timeout extended for multiplayer character selection

Thank you as always for your continued support, it really means a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/08232afcfc4bb7cf22814eacea05266c6da26f8f.gif[/img]

notes.title: We are Steam Deck Verified! Play early to celebrate!
notes.content:
It’s official; PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe is now Steam Deck Verified!

We’ve been working hard to develop the best possible experience on Deck and we’re thrilled to have received an official Verified rating from Valve. 

[list]
[*] All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configuration
[*] Shows Steam Deck controller icons
[*] In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
[*] Default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck
[/list]
This means that you can clean up the streets of Junktown on the go and from the comfort of your Steam Deck, wherever you are! 

To celebrate, a demo for PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe is available right now! Head straight to Junktown and experience throwing down with your friends online from the comfort of your Steam Deck.

We’ll have more updates to share with you soon, so watch this space and thanks for your continued support.

Team Scrappers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42761072/73ddfa51da792c0c13067a3193afee5d49c28a51.jpg[/img]
